profile.headline: Signal Processing Algorithms and Software
profile.summary: Fifteen years of hands-on experience in wireless communications and radar.  A strong contributor in previous positions, from architecture phase through development and integration.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Algorithms and Vehicle Dynamics
System Engineer. Modeling and Simulation
positions.description:
Title transition from Algorithm Engineer at Argon ST, after Argon was purchased by Boeing.  SW Architect for 54-channel phased-array RADAR system using COTS tuners and HPC SBCs. 
 Beamforming, DF, and signal tracking algorithm studies for VLF Geopositioning in GPS-denied ares.  Responsible for analysis and simulation of current and proposed approaches for airborne SIGINT system.  Primary engineer in charge of changes to Direction Finding and Geolocation algorithms, a core and critical aspect of the system function.

positions.title: Algorithm Engineer
positions.description:
•	Went from no background in Direction Finding to lead Engineer on several projects advancing System functionality in DF and related Geo-location techniques.
•	Wrote Matlab code for simulation, adaptive array beam-forming, wireless protocol exploitation, and system performance analysis.
•	Frequently selected as sole technical representative to accompany management on product and marketing-related customer visits.
•	Wrote requirements and CONOP documents for SIGINT system enhancements, and worked closely with SW team through test vector support and System I&T.
•	Involved at all levels of system processing, from real-time FPGA data-interfaces of embedded airborne subsystem, through chain to post-mission processing of results from multi-system database.

positions.title: DSP Dept. Manager
positions.description:
Department Manager responsible for DSP Software effort in developing WiMAX-extending wireless data system.
•	Oversaw staffing, projected scope of effort, selected processors, analyzed HW/SW breakdown of responsibilities.
•	Architected System Integration and Test flow, from prototype HW and Ethernet-simulated airlink, to full WiMAX-extending SoC CPE and 16 antenna base station.  
•	Implemented software design and development process.
•	Major contributor to wireless air interface and system design.
•	Managed team of six DSP software engineers.

positions.title: DSP SW Engineer
positions.description:
Senior DSP software engineer on wireless analysis project.
•	Ported from x86 single-system with two local FPGA interfaces, to 4 boards of 4 PPC CPUs and 8 FPGAs, interconnected by StarFabric packet switch network.
•	Reduced data copying and used AltiVec to meet performance goals.

positions.title: DSP SW Engineer
positions.description:
DSP software engineer on wireless telecom system.
•	Responsible for telecom system RF diagnostic and calibration function; design, software and interfaces
•	Wrote GUI and embedded data-servers used internally and externally for system observations.
•	Contributed at every layer of system, from customer premise equipment to back-haul interface.

positions.title: DSP SW Engineer
positions.description:
DSP Engineer for defense SIGINT application.
•	Designed and produces high-speed embedded code, distributed across 14 processors with a mix of interconnect pathways.
•	Modules included drivers, sorting, tracking, and analysis of events.
